pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[Female Vocal]
(Soft raspy breath and a close hush in the first seconds over wide stereo air. Pulsing pad enters with resonant sub bass, sparse water-drop pluck, 92 BPM slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. No big melody.)
shh...
not yet
already
your star

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal]
(Soft raspy spoken delivery, choppy and consonant-driven, each word locked to kick and snare. Pulsing pads, warm sub bass, clean low-end, controlled reverb.)
dark street
I walk
alone
each step
carves
your name
cold wind
hits
the bone
you rise
and I
lose air

[Pre-Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(Closer mic, more vocal fry, ghost kicks between the hits, pads pulse tighter, space before the hook.)
no words
just
your heat
it thawed
my winter
slow
that fingertip
still
stays
on me

[Hook]
[Female Vocal]
(0.5 second gap of almost-silence, then a phonetic loop. Short clipped words, percussive, near-monotone, last syllable dragged with raspy breathy fade.)
touch low
still light
touch low
still light
touch low
still light
come back

[Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(Spoken cadence over the full groove. Kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, sub bass following the kick, water-drop pluck answering the last word of each line.)
your smile
is
the whole
far off
still
it lands
a small
light
in the chest
your light
hits
me
I go
back
to life

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
(Same spoken grid, a little more grit in the rasp. Soft rain-window delay, pads stay rhythmic not lush.)
wet glass
gray
sky days
one voice
stops
the room
a flower
inside
the storm
new skin
over
the break
my name
from you
stands me

[Pre-Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(Tighter phrasing, almost whispered consonants, tiny silence before Hook 2.)
your smile
turns
to force
distance
doesn't
end it
your light
hits
me
I go
back
to life

[Hook 2]
[Female Vocal]
(Same phonetic loop, slightly wider stereo, last "back" held with vocal fry.)
touch low
still light
touch low
still light
touch low
still light
come back

[Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(Energy lifts without turning into a sung chorus. More presence in the rasp, still spoken, still behind the snare.)
your smile
holds
the night
far off
I
still reach
your light
hits
me
I go
back
to life
I run
into
your dark

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal]
(Intimate, close, almost spoken into the mic. Minimal drums, pulsing pad only.)
some nights
without you
run long
no stars
just
the street
then your line
comes back
I'll be
your star
that line
keeps
me here

[Rap]
[Female Rap]
(Low, close, breathy, beat-locked. Words sit in the gaps between kick and snare. Minimal, intimate, no extra melody.)
now I move
toward you
into
that dark
I take
your hand
I turn
to light
you lived
in me
I live
in you
we both
come back
not loud
just close
touch
you
stay

[Break]
[Female Vocal]
(Almost empty bar. Humming and sub bass only, one water-drop pluck, then a short silence before the final chorus.)
mmh...
still light

[Final Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(Full groove returns. Spoken hook repeated and stretched, last syllables longer, raspy fade and fry. Keep it rhythm-first, never sung.)
your smile
turns
forever
years pass
it
doesn't move
I run
to where
you are
your light
hit me
first
now I
reach
you back
we live
again
slow
the quiet
fills
with breath
I go
back
to life
touch low
still light
touch you

[Outro]
[Female Vocal]
(Groove thins out. Pad pulse and sub bass remain. Close raspy whisper, last word fades with fry into air.)
dark street
not alone
your hand
in mine
touch you
pkg.sunoStyle: Groovy airy electro-pop with groove. Minimal, rhythm-driven, laid-back, subtly sensual. Tempo: 92 BPM, slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. Drums: kick on 1 and 3, ghost kicks between; snare/clap on 2 and 4. Arrangement: resonant sub bass follows kick, pulsing pads drive rhythm, water-drop pluck for melody. Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.
